title: Chain-of-Thought Hub: A Continuous Effort to Measure Large Language Models' Reasoning Performance
reasoning: The paper introduces Chain-of-Thought Hub, an open-source evaluation suite focused on measuring the reasoning performance of LLMs using benchmarks primarily related to math, coding, and general knowledge. While it mentions the importance of RLHF and cites papers on 'helpful and harmless' models and 'Constitutional AI' in its broader discussion of LLM development, the core benchmarking and datasets compiled in this work do not directly evaluate or benchmark faith, ethics, or morals.
